title: YEAR, MONTH and DAY of November 20, 2008
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "y", YEAR ( DATE ( 2008, 11, 20 ) ), "m", MONTH ( DATE ( 2008, 11, 20 ) ), "d", DAY ( DATE ( 2008, 11, 20 ) ) )

source.quote: Extract date parts from a date
source.supports: the example table lists 2008-11-20 with Year 2008, Month 11, Day 20; Return values: a single integer value

source.quote: Returns the year of a date as a four digit integer in the range 1900-9999.
